items.html: Know that the essential place of the worlds and their true degree is thus, according to this order, and this is the fitting place for them to always be. The reason is that Zeir Anpin must grow and become like Arich Anpin, and therefore he must rise up to there. And the place of Arich Anpin must become the place of Zeir Anpin, for through this Zeir Anpin becomes ‘Arich’ [long]. And the Nukva of Zeir Anpin rises to the place of Aba, by the secret of ‘the Lord founded the earth in Hochma,’ for Aba founds the daughter; and by the secret of ‘you shall keep the Sabbath, for it is holy,’ for ‘keep,’ which is the female, becomes ‘holy,’ which is Aba, and this is why it is written ‘it is holy, for she’ — the female — returned to being holy. And Beriah rose into Ima, by the secret of what you know, that Ima nests in the throne. And Yetzira rises to the place of Zeir Anpin, for Zeir Anpin nests in the angel. And Assiya rises into the Nukva of Zeir Anpin, for Malchut nests in what is Assiya. Thus this is the fitting place for the order of the degree of the worlds.
